<json>
{
  "states": [
    "CLOSED",
    "LISTEN",
    "REQUEST",
    "RESPOND",
    "PARTOPEN",
    "OPEN",
    "CLOSEREQ",
    "CLOSING",
    "TIMEWAIT"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "CLOSED",
      "event": "",
      "action": "snd Request",
      "to": "REQUEST"
    },
    {
      "from": "LISTEN",
      "event": "rcv Request",
      "action": "snd Response",
      "to": "RESPOND"
    },
    {
      "from": "LISTEN",
      "event": "",
      "action": "Generate Reset(No Connection)",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    },
    {
      "from": "REQUEST",
      "event": "rcv Response",
      "action": "Move to PARTOPEN, snd Ack",
      "to": "PARTOPEN"
    },
    {
      "from": "REQUEST",
      "event": "",
      "action": "Generate Reset(Packet Error)",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    },
    {
      "from": "RESPOND",
      "event": "rcv Ack/DataAck",
      "action": "Move to OPEN",
      "to": "OPEN"
    },
    {
      "from": "RESPOND",
      "event": "",
      "action": "Generate Reset(No Connection)",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    },
    {
      "from": "RESPOND",
      "event": "timeout >= 4MSL",
      "action": "snd Reset(Aborted), Move to CLOSED",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    },
    {
      "from": "PARTOPEN",
      "event": "rcv packet (not Response, Reset, Sync)",
      "action": "Move to OPEN",
      "to": "OPEN"
    },
    {
      "from": "PARTOPEN",
      "event": "",
      "action": "snd Ack",
      "to": "PARTOPEN"
    },
    {
      "from": "PARTOPEN",
      "event": "timeout >= 4MSL",
      "action": "Reset connection(Aborted)",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    },
    {
      "from": "OPEN",
      "event": "",
      "action": "snd CloseReq",
      "to": "CLOSEREQ"
    },
    {
      "from": "OPEN",
      "event": "rcv CloseReq",
      "action": "Move to CLOSING, snd Close",
      "to": "CLOSING"
    },
    {
      "from": "CLOSEREQ",
      "event": "rcv Close",
      "action": "snd Reset(Closed)",
      "to": "TIMEWAIT"
    },
    {
      "from": "CLOSEREQ",
      "event": "",
      "action": "snd CloseReq",
      "to": "CLOSEREQ"
    },
    {
      "from": "CLOSING",
      "event": "rcv Reset",
      "action": "Move to TIMEWAIT",
      "to": "TIMEWAIT"
    },
    {
      "from": "CLOSING",
      "event": "",
      "action": "snd Close",
      "to": "CLOSING"
    },
    {
      "from": "TIMEWAIT",
      "event": "2MSL timer expires",
      "action": "Move to CLOSED",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    }
  ]
}
</json>
